item.title: Serious injuries reported in West Lubbock crash on Marsha Sharp
item.description: LUBBOCK, Texas-- The Lubbock Police Department confirmed that one person sustained serious injuries and another sustained moderate injuries after a crash on Wednesday afternoon near West Loop 289 and Marsha Sharp Freeway. According to LPD, the initial call came in at approximately 12:40 p.m. This is a developing story. Visit EverythingLubbock.com for further details.
